newsitem.title: UK: Copper holds at lows during late LME trade.
newsitem.headline: Copper holds at lows during late LME trade.

text.p: Copper prices managed to hold their lows during Monday evening LME trading, but remained sharply below pre-weekend levels after an earlier sell-off.
Traders said the sell-stops that hit the market during the kerb session petered out around the $2,170/75 a tonne level, alllowing the market to stabilise.

However, sentiment is negative, based on narrowing spread backwardations, expectations of an inventory increase of some 3,000 tonnes on Tuesday, and less concern over upside call options ahead of Wednesday declarations.
At 1900 three months was indicated at $2,170/75 a tonne, down from $2,187 at 1700, and well below last Friday's $2,242 close.
Aluminium was quoted at $1,516/1,518 a tonne.
